approvedScope: NAS compute service, Mac workers, CLI and operations dashboard; governed development dispatch later

cases.claim: Release scope, authority and exact source/tool provenance are recorded.
1000 distinct named seeds with >=64 model steps pass.
Unauthorized and tampered requests cannot mutate the queue.
Consumed request remains rejected after reopening the server/store.
Concurrent nonce consumers produce at most one acceptance.
Expired, replaced and wrong-worker attempts cannot accept outputs.
Completion retry after lost response preserves one event and correct bytes.
Filesystem/DB interruption cannot create a dangling accepted result.
Every targeted broken guard fails its named behavioral assertion.
Independent checker rejects missing cases, skipped evidence and tampered hashes.
Two clean pinned workspace installs match normalized manifests and outputs.
Actual linux/amd64 image builds, runs nonroot and serves a signed fixture job/readback.
Portable library package installs with its real API and no home/cache dependency.
NAS process/reboot recovery and storage/auth readiness meet declared limits.
Both Macs join, obtain inputs and obey handler/resource/power/time policies.
CLI/browser agree on revision, freshness, trace and protected/redacted status.
Actual sleep/network faults preserve fenced results and bounded eligible recovery.
HelpDesk and FleetRunner fail independently; coordination is not execution authority.
Independent backup and generation-safe paused restores meet recovery objectives.
One coordinator and rollback preserve authority through cutover and 48h acceptance.
